mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over the preceding 6 months raises real discount rates, reducing present value of future corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25% per month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: If S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or if the mechanism fails during a recession (UNRATE < 5%).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls YoY for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: If S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes or if GDP growth turns positive before the horizon ends.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which depresses consumer spending and corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 6.0% and remains there for 3 months
failure_condition: If S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or if unemployment falls below 6% before the horizon ends.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals supply-side stress, which raises input costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-mo moving average for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: If S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly below zero in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above their respective 12-month averages signals a monetary tightening accompanied by rising inflation, which increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both exceed 12-mo average in the same month
failure_condition: If S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or if inflation falls below the 12-month average before the horizon ends.

mechanism_narrative: A strong, persistent increase in housing starts (HOUST) above its 6-month moving average for three consecutive months signals a housing market recovery, which boosts construction-related equities and supports broader market sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 6-mo moving average for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: If S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly above zero in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous fall in both UNRATE and PAYEMS below their 12-month averages in the same month signals a significant labor market downturn, which reduces aggregate demand and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE and PAYEMS both fall below 12-mo average in the same month
failure_condition: If S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or if either UNRATE or PAYEMS rebounds above their 12-month average before the horizon ends.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in real personal savings (proxied by RSAFS rising YoY for four consecutive months) signals a shift from consumption to saving, which reduces near-term demand for goods and services and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises YoY for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: If S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or if RSAFS growth turns negative before the horizon ends.
